cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Say You Saw It Too
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit noticing the impossible detail before you reveal how much you believe it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Before you send this soup back, did you notice anything moving?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm complaining about cold noodles. What did you see?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Tell me whether one waved. I need your word before I explain.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It waved me closer. I'm still not eating it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'll understand why I've ordered it lunch. Could you ask whether it wants your bread?

mechanism: A copies a waiter wave as recognition of a living noodle and waits for B admission before revealing an already ordered lunch for it.
confusable: D160 corroboration before depth; D155 openly requests action on premise from start.
comparison: Silent shadow witnessing versus restaurant complaint.
seedUse: Preserve B no-eating boundary making A request bread for the noodle instead.
